maddeler.e:
أتساوم (form VI)
# أَتَسَاوَمُ (ʔatasāwamu) /ʔa.ta.saː.wa.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَسَاوَمَ (tasāwama)
# أَتَسَاوَمَ (ʔatasāwama) /ʔa.ta.saː.wa.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَسَاوَمَ (tasāwama)
# أَتَسَاوَمْ (ʔatasāwam) /ʔa.ta.saː.wam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَسَاوَمَ (tasāwama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
